articles.title: Deutsche Bank: Q1 Earnings Snapshot
articles.summary: Associated Press: Deutsche Bank: Q1 Earnings Snapshot. FRANKFURT, Germany (AP) — Deutsche Bank AG (DB) on Wednesday reported net income of $2.42 billion in its first quarter. The Frankfurt, Germany-based bank said it had earnings of $1.24 per share. The bank posted revenue of $17.89 billion in the period.
